mn94:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā udeno bārāṇasiyaṃ viharati khemiyambavane.
mn94:2.1: tena kho pana samayena ghoṭamukho brāhmaṇo bārāṇasiṃ anuppatto hoti kenacideva karaṇīyena.
mn94:2.2: atha kho ghoṭamukho brāhmaṇo jaṅghāvihāraṃ anucaṅkamamāno anuvicaramāno yena khemiyambavanaṃ tenupasaṅkami.
mn94:2.3: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā udeno abbhokāse caṅkamati.
mn94:2.4: atha kho so ghoṭamukho brāhmaṇo yenāyasmā udeno tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā udenena saddhiṃ sammodi.
mn94:2.5: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā āyasmantaṃ udenaṃ caṅkamantaṃ anucaṅkamamāno evamāha:
mn94:2.8: tañca kho bhavantarūpānaṃ vā adassanā, yo vā panettha dhammo’ti.
mn94:3.1: evaṃ vutte āyasmā udeno caṅkamā orohitvā vihāraṃ pavisitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
mn94:3.2: ghoṭamukhopi kho brāhmaṇo caṅkamā orohitvā vihāraṃ pavisitvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi.
mn94:3.3: ekamantaṃ ṭhitaṃ kho ghoṭamukhaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ āyasmā udeno etadavoca:
mn94:3.6: etadeva kho pana mayaṃ bhoto udenassa āgamayamānā na nisīdāma.
mn94:3.7: kathaṃ hi nāma mādiso pubbe animantito āsane nisīditabbaṃ maññeyyā’ti.
mn94:4.1: atha kho ghoṭamukho brāhmaṇo aññataraṃ nīcaṃ āsanaṃ gahetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
mn94:4.2: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho ghoṭamukho brāhmaṇo āyasmantaṃ udenaṃ etadavoca:
mn94:4.5: tañca kho bhavantarūpānaṃ vā adassanā, yo vā panettha dhammo’ti.
mn94:4.6: sace kho pana me tvaṃ brāhmaṇa, anuññeyyaṃ anujāneyyāsi, paṭikkositabbañca paṭikkoseyyāsi, yassa ca pana me bhāsitassa atthaṃ na jāneyyāsi, mamaṃyeva tattha uttariṃ paṭipuccheyyāsi:
mn94:4.7: idaṃ bho udena kathaṃ, imassa kvatthoti? evaṃ katvā siyā no ettha kathāsallāpoti.
mn94:4.8: anuññeyyaṃ khvāhaṃ bhoto udenassa anujānissāmi, paṭikkositabbañca paṭikkosissāmi. yassa ca panāhaṃ bhoto udenassa bhāsitassa atthaṃ na jānissāmi, bhavantaṃyeva tattha udenaṃ uttariṃ paṭipucchissāmi: idaṃ bho udena kathaṃ, imassa kvattho’ti? evaṃ katvā hotu no ettha kathāsallāpoti.
mn94:5.1: cattārome brāhmaṇa, puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ.
mn94:5.3: idha brāhmaṇa, ekacco puggalo attantapo hoti attaparitāpanānuyogamanuyutto.
mn94:5.4: idha pana brāhmaṇa, ekacco puggalo parantapo hoti paraparitāpanānuyogamanuyutto.
mn94:5.5: idha brāhmaṇa, ekacco puggalo attantapo ca hoti attaparitāpanānuyogamanuyutto, parantapo ca paraparitāpanānuyogamanuyutto.
mn94:5.6: idha pana brāhmaṇa, ekacco puggalo nevattantapo hoti nāttaparitāpanānuyogamanuyutto, na parantapo na paraparitāpanānuyogamanuyutto.
mn94:5.7: so anattantapo aparantapo diṭṭheva dhamme nicchāto nibbuto sītībhūto sukhapaṭisaṃvedī brahmabhūtena attanā viharati.
mn94:5.8: imesaṃ brāhmaṇa, catunnaṃ puggalānaṃ katamo te puggalo cittaṃ ārādhetī’ti?
mn94:5.9: yvāyaṃ bho udena, puggalo attantapo attaparitāpanānuyogamanuyutto, ayaṃ me puggalo cittaṃ nārādheti.
mn94:5.10: yopāyaṃ bho udena, puggalo parantapo paraparitāpanānuyogamanuyutto, ayampi me puggalo cittaṃ nārādheti.
mn94:5.11: yopāyaṃ bho udena, puggalo attantapo ca attaparitāpanānuyogamanuyutto parantapo ca paraparitāpanānuyogamanuyutto, ayampi me puggalo cittaṃ nārādheti.
mn94:5.12: yo ca kho ayaṃ bho udena, puggalo nevattantapo nāttaparitāpanānuyogamanuyutto na parantapo na paraparitāpanānuyogamanuyutto, so anattantapo aparantapo diṭṭhevadhamme nicchāto nibbuto sītībhūto sukhapaṭisaṃvedī brahmabhūtena attanā viharati.
mn94:6.1: kasmā pana te brāhmaṇa, ime tayo puggalā cittaṃ nārādhentī’ti?
mn94:6.2: yvāyaṃ bho udena, puggalo attantapo attaparitāpanānuyogamanuyutto, so attānaṃ sukhakāmaṃ dukkhapaṭikkūlaṃ ātāpeti paritāpeti,
mn94:6.3: iminā me ayaṃ puggalo cittaṃ nārādheti.
mn94:6.4: yopāyaṃ bho udena, puggalo parantapo paraparitāpanānuyogamanuyutto, so paraṃ sukhakāmaṃ dukkhapaṭikkūlaṃ ātāpeti paritāpeti,
mn94:6.5: iminā me ayaṃ puggalo cittaṃ nārādheti.
mn94:6.6: yopāyaṃ bho udena, puggalo attantapo ca attaparitāpanānuyogamanuyutto, parantapo ca paraparitāpanānuyogamanuyutto, so attānañca parañca sukhakāmaṃ dukkhapaṭikkūlaṃ ātāpeti paritāpeti,
mn94:6.7: iminā me ayaṃ puggalo cittaṃ nārādheti.
mn94:6.8: yo ca kho ayaṃ bho udena, puggalo nevattantapo nāttaparitāpanānuyogamanuyutto na parantapo na paraparitāpanānuyogamanuyutto, so anattantapo aparantapo diṭṭhevadhamme nicchāto nibbuto sītībhūto sukhapaṭisaṃvedī brahmabhūtena attanā viharati. so attānañca parañca sukhakāme dukkhapaṭikkūle neva ātāpeti, na paritāpeti.
mn94:6.9: iminā me ayaṃ puggalo cittaṃ ārādhetī’ti.
mn94:7.3: idha brāhmaṇa, ekaccā parisā sārattarattā maṇikuṇḍalesu puttabhariyaṃ pariyesati, dāsidāsaṃ pariyesati, khettavatthuṃ pariyesati, jātarūparajataṃ pariyesati.
mn94:7.4: idha pana brāhmaṇa, ekaccā parisā asārattarattā maṇikuṇḍalesu puttabhariyaṃ pahāya, dāsidāsaṃ pahāya, khettavatthuṃ pahāya, jātarūparajataṃ pahāya, agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitā.
mn94:7.5: yvāyaṃ brāhmaṇa, puggalo nevattantapo nāttaparitāpanānuyogamanuyutto na parantapo na paraparitāpanānuyogamanuyutto,
mn94:7.6: so anattantapo aparantapo diṭṭhevadhamme nicchāto nibbuto sītībhūto sukhapaṭisaṃvedī brahmabhūtena attanā viharati.
mn94:7.7: idha tvaṃ, brāhmaṇa, puggalaṃ katamassaṃ parisāyaṃ bahulaṃ samanupassasi:
mn94:7.8: yā cāyaṃ parisā sārattarattā maṇikuṇḍalesu puttabhariyaṃ pariyesati, dāsidāsaṃ pariyesati, khettavatthuṃ pariyesati, jātarūparajataṃ pariyesati. yā cāyaṃ parisā asārattarattā maṇikuṇḍalesu puttabhariyaṃ pahāya dāsidāsaṃ pahāya khettavatthuṃ pahāya jātarūparajataṃ pahāya agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitā’ti.
mn94:7.9: yvāyaṃ bho udena, puggalo nevattantapo nāttaparitāpanānuyogamanuyutto, na parantapo na paraparitāpanānuyogamanuyutto, so anattantapo aparantapo diṭṭhevadhamme nicchāto nibbuto sītībhūto sukhapaṭisaṃvedī brahmabhūtena attanā viharati.
mn94:7.10: imāhaṃ puggalaṃ yāyaṃ parisā asārattarattā maṇikuṇḍalesu puttabhariyaṃ pahāya dāsidāsaṃ pahāya khettavatthuṃ pahāya jātarūparajataṃ pahāya agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitā, imissaṃ parisāyaṃ bahulaṃ samanupassāmī’ti.
mn94:8.1: idāneva kho pana te brāhmaṇa, bhāsitaṃ: mayaṃ evaṃ ājānāma,
mn94:8.4: tañca kho bhavantarūpānaṃ vā adassanā, yo vā panettha dhammo’ti.
mn94:8.5: addhāmesā bho udena, sānuggahā vācā bhāsitā.
mn94:8.8: evañca pana maṃ bhavaṃ udeno dhāretu.
mn94:8.9: yecime bhotā udenena cattāro puggelā saṃkhittena vuttā vitthārena avibhattā, sādhu me bhavaṃ udeno ime cattāro puggale vitthārena vibhajatu anukampaṃ upādāyāti.
mn94:9.1: tena hi brāhmaṇa, suṇāhi, sādhukaṃ manasi karohi, bhāsissāmīti.
mn94:9.2: evaṃ bhoti kho ghoṭamukho brāhmaṇo āyasmato udenassa paccassosi.
mn94:10.1: katamo ca brāhmaṇa, puggalo attantapo attaparitāpanānuyogamanuyutto:
mn94:10.2: idha brāhmaṇa, ekacco puggalo acelako hoti muttācāro, hatthāvalekhano na ehibhadantiko na tiṭṭhabhadantiko nābhihaṭaṃ na uddissa kaṭaṃ na nimantanaṃ sādiyati.
mn94:10.3: so na kumbhimukhā patigaṇhāti, na kaḷopimukhā patigaṇhāti, na eḷakamantaraṃ na daṇḍamantaraṃ na musalamantaraṃ na dvinnaṃ bhuñjamānānaṃ na gabbhiniyā na pāyamānāya na purisantaragatāya na saṅkittīsu na yattha sā upaṭṭhito hoti, na yattha makkhikā saṇḍasaṇḍacārinī, na macchaṃ na maṃsaṃ na suraṃ na merayaṃ na thusodakaṃ pivati.
mn94:10.4: so ekāgāriko vā hoti ekālopiko vā, dvāgāriko vā hoti dvālopiko vā …pe… sattāgāriko vā hoti sattālopiko vā,
mn94:10.5: ekissāpi dattiyā yāpeti, dvīhipi dattīhi yāpeti …pe… sattahipi dattīhi yāpeti.
mn94:10.6: ekāhikampi āhāraṃ āhāreti, dvīhikampi āhāraṃ āhāreti …pe… sattāhikampi āhāraṃ āhāreti. iti evarūpaṃ addhamāsikampi pariyāyabhattabhojanānuyogamanuyutto viharati.
mn94:10.7: so sākabhakkho vā hoti, sāmākabhakkho vā hoti, nīvārabhakkho vā hoti, daddulabhakkho vā hoti, haṭabhakkho vā hoti, kaṇabhakkho vā hoti, ācāmabhakkho vā hoti, piññākabhakkho vā hoti, tiṇabhakkho vā hoti, gomayabhakkho vā hoti, vanamūlaphalāhāro yāpeti pavattaphalabhojī.
mn94:10.8: so sāṇānipi dhāreti, masāṇānipi dhāreti, chavadussānipi dhāreti, paṃsukūlānipi dhāreti, tirīṭānipi dhāreti, ajinānipi dhāreti, ajinakkhipampi dhāreti, kusacīrampi dhāreti, vākacīrampi dhāreti, phalakacīrampi dhāreti, kesakambalampi dhāreti, vāḷakambalampi dhāreti, ulūkapakkhampi dhāreti.
mn94:10.14: iti evarūpaṃ anekavihitaṃ kāyassa ātāpanaparitāpanānuyogamanuyutto viharati.
mn94:10.15: ayaṃ vuccati brāhmaṇa, puggalo attantapo attaparitāpanānuyogamanuyutto.
mn94:11.1: katamo ca brāhmaṇa, puggalo parantapo paraparitāpanānuyogamanuyutto:
mn94:11.2: idha brāhmaṇa, ekacco puggalo orabbhiko hoti, sūkariko sākuntiko māgaviko ḷuddo macchaghātako coro coraghātako bandhanāgāriko, ye vā panaññepi keci kurūrakammantā.
mn94:11.3: ayaṃ vuccati brāhmaṇa, puggalo parantapo paraparitāpanānuyogamanuyutto.
mn94:12.1: katamo ca brāhmaṇa, puggalo attantapo ca attaparitāpanānuyogamanuyutto, parantapo ca paraparitāpanānuyogamanuyutto:
mn94:12.2: idha brāhmaṇa, ekacco puggalo rājā vā hoti khattiyo muddhābhisitto, brāhmaṇo vā mahāsāḷo.
mn94:12.3: so puratthimena nagarassa navaṃ santhāgāraṃ kārāpetvā kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kharājinaṃ nivāsetvā sappitelena kāyaṃ abbhañjitvā migavisāṇena piṭṭhiṃ kaṇḍuvamāno santhāgāraṃ pavisati saddhiṃ mahesiyā brāhmaṇena ca purohitena.
mn94:12.4: so tattha anantarahitāya bhūmiyā haritupattāya seyyaṃ kappeti.
mn94:12.5: ekissā gāviyā sarūpavacchāya yaṃ ekasmiṃ thane khīraṃ hoti, tena rājā yāpeti. yaṃ dutiyasmiṃ thane khīraṃ hoti, tena mahesī yāpeti. yaṃ tatiyasmiṃ thane khīraṃ hoti, tena brāhmaṇo purohito yāpeti. yaṃ catutthasmiṃ thane khīraṃ hoti, tena aggiṃ juhanti. avasesena vacchako yāpeti.
mn94:12.7: ‘ettakā usabhā haññantu yaññatthāya, ettakā vacchatarā haññantu yaññatthāya, ettikā vacchatariyo haññantu yaññatthāya, ettakā ajā haññantu yaññatthāya, ettakā urabbhā haññantu yaññatthāya, ettakā rukkhā chijjantu yūpatthāya, ettakā dabbhā lūyantu barihisatthāyā’ti.
mn94:12.8: yepissa te honti dāsāti vā pessāti vā kammakarāti vā, tepi daṇḍatajjitā bhayatajjitā assumukhā rudamānā parikammāni karonti.
mn94:12.9: ayaṃ vuccati brāhmaṇa, puggalo attantapo ca attaparitāpanānuyogamanuyutto, parantapo ca paraparitāpanānuyogamanuyutto.
mn94:13.1: katamo ca brāhmaṇa, puggalo nevattantapo nāttaparitāpanānuyogamanuyutto, na parantapo na paraparitāpanānuyogamanuyutto,
mn94:13.2: so anattantapo aparantapo diṭṭhevadhamme nicchāto nibbuto sītībhūto sukhapaṭisaṃvedī brahmabhūtena attanā viharati:
mn94:14.1: ‘idha brāhmaṇa, tathāgato loke uppajjati arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā.
mn94:14.2: so imaṃ lokaṃ sadevakaṃ samārakaṃ sabrahmakaṃ sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiṃ pajaṃ sadevamanussaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā pavedeti.
mn94:14.3: so dhammaṃ deseti ādikalyāṇaṃ majjhekalyāṇaṃ pariyosānakalyāṇaṃ sātthaṃ sabyañjanaṃ kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ pakāseti.
mn94:15.1: taṃ dhammaṃ suṇāti gahapati vā gahapatiputto vā aññatarasmiṃ kule paccājāto.
mn94:15.2: so taṃ dhammaṃ sutvā tathāgate saddhaṃ paṭilabhati.
mn94:15.3: so tena saddhā paṭilābhena samannāgato iti paṭisañcikkhati:
mn94:15.5: nayidaṃ sukaraṃ agāraṃ ajjhāvasatā ekantaparipuṇṇaṃ ekantaparisuddhaṃ saṅkhalikhitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ carituṃ.
mn94:15.6: yannūnāhaṃ kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajeyya’nti.
mn94:15.7: so aparena samayena appaṃ vā bhogakkhandhaṃ pahāya mahantaṃ vā bhogakkhandhaṃ pahāya appaṃ vā ñātiparivaṭṭaṃ pahāya mahantaṃ vā ñātiparivaṭṭaṃ pahāya kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajati.
mn94:15.8: so evaṃ pabbajito samāno bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāsājīvasamāpanno pāṇātipātaṃ pahāya pāṇātipātā paṭivirato hoti, nihitadaṇḍo nihitasattho lajjī dayāpanno sabbapāṇabhūtahitānukampī viharati.
mn94:16.1: adinnādānaṃ pahāya adinnādānā paṭivirato hoti dinnādāyī dinnapāṭikaṅkhī. athenena sucibhūtena attanā viharati.
mn94:16.2: abrahmacariyaṃ pahāya brahmacārī hoti ārācārī virato methunā gāmadhammā.
mn94:16.3: musāvādaṃ pahāya musāvādā paṭivirato hoti saccavādī saccasandho theto paccayiko avisaṃvādako lokassa.
mn94:16.4: pisuṇaṃ vācaṃ pahāya pisunāya vācāya paṭivirato hoti. ito sutvā na amutra akkhātā imesaṃ bhedāya amutra vā sutvā na imesaṃ akkhātā amūsaṃ bhedāya. iti bhinnānaṃ vā sandhātā sahitānaṃ vā anuppadātā, samaggārāmo samaggarato samagganandī samaggakaraṇiṃ vācaṃ bhāsitā hoti.
mn94:16.5: pharusaṃ vācaṃ pahāya pharusāya vācāya paṭivirato hoti. yā sā vācā nelā kaṇṇasukhā pemanīyā hadayaṅgamā porī bahujanakantā bahujanamanāpā, tathārūpiṃ vācaṃ bhāsitā hoti.
mn94:16.6: samphappalāpaṃ pahāya samphappalāpā paṭivirato hoti, kālavādī bhūtavādī atthavādī dhammavādī vinayavādī nidhānavatiṃ vācaṃ bhāsitā kālena sāpadesaṃ pariyantavatiṃ atthasaṃhitaṃ.
mn94:17.1: so santuṭṭho hoti kāyaparihārikena cīvarena kucchiparihārikena piṇḍapātena. so yena yeneva pakkamati samādāyeva pakkamati.
mn94:17.2: seyyathāpi nāma pakkhī sakuṇo yena yeneva ḍeti, sapattabhārova ḍeti,
mn94:17.3: evamevaṃ bhikkhu santuṭṭho hoti kāyaparihārikena cīvarena, kucchiparihārikena piṇḍapātena, yena yeneva pakkamati samādāyeva pakkamati.
mn94:17.4: so iminā ariyena sīlakkhandhena samannāgato ajjhattaṃ anavajjasukhaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti.
mn94:18.1: so cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā na nimittaggāhī hoti nānubyañjanaggāhī.
mn94:18.2: yatvādhikaraṇamenaṃ cakkhundriyaṃ asaṃvutaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhādomanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssaveyyuṃ, tassa saṃvarāya paṭipajjati rakkhati cakkhundriyaṃ cakkhundriye saṃvaraṃ āpajjati.
mn94:18.7: manasā dhammaṃ viññāya na nimittaggāhī hoti nānubyañjanaggāhī.
mn94:18.8: yatvādhikaraṇamenaṃ manindriyaṃ asaṃvutaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhā domanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssaveyyuṃ, tassa saṃvarāya paṭipajjati, rakkhati manindriyaṃ, manindriye saṃvaraṃ āpajjati.
mn94:18.9: so iminā ariyena indriyasaṃvarena samannāgato ajjhattaṃ abyāsekasukhaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti.
mn94:19.1: so abhikkante paṭikkante sampajānakārī hoti, ālokite vilokite sampajānakārī hoti, samiñjite pasārite sampajānakārī hoti, saṅghāṭipattacīvaradhāraṇe sampajānakārī hoti, asite pīte khāyite sāyite sampajānakārī hoti, uccārapassāvakamme sampajānakārī hoti, gate ṭhite nisinne sutte jāgarite bhāsite tuṇhībhāve sampajānakārī hoti.
mn94:20.1: so iminā ca ariyena sīlakkhandhena samannāgato, iminā ca ariyena indriyasaṃvarena samannāgato, iminā ca ariyena satisampajaññena samannāgato,
mn94:20.2: vivittaṃ senāsanaṃ bhajati: araññaṃ rukkhamūlaṃ pabbataṃ kandaraṃ giriguhaṃ susānaṃ vanapatthaṃ abbhokāsaṃ palālapuñjaṃ.
mn94:21.1: so pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto nisīdati pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā, ujuṃ kāyaṃ panidhāya, parimukhaṃ satiṃ upaṭṭhapetvā.
mn94:21.2: so abhijjhaṃ loke pahāya vigatābhijjhena cetasā viharati, abhijjhāya cittaṃ parisodheti,
mn94:21.3: byāpādapadosaṃ pahāya abyāpannacitto viharati sabbapāṇabhūtāhitānukampī, byāpādapadosā cittaṃ parisodheti,
mn94:21.4: thinamiddhaṃ pahāya vigatathīnamiddho viharati ālokasaññī sato sampajāno thīnamiddhā cittaṃ parisodheti,
mn94:21.5: uddhaccakukkuccaṃ pahāya anuddhato viharati ajjhattaṃ vūpasantacitto, uddhaccakukkuccā cittaṃ parisodheti,
mn94:21.6: vicikicchaṃ pahāya tiṇṇavicikiccho viharati akathaṅkathī kusalesu dhammesu, vicikicchāya cittaṃ parisodheti.
mn94:22.1: so ime pañcanīvaraṇe pahāya cetaso upakkilese paññāya dubbalīkaraṇe
mn94:22.2: vivicceva akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
mn94:23.1: vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā ajjhattaṃ sampasādanaṃ cetaso ekodibhāvaṃ avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ samādhijaṃ pītisukhaṃ dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
mn94:24.1: pītiyā ca virāgā upekkhako ca viharati sato ca sampajāno, sukhañca kāyena paṭisaṃvedeti, yaṃ taṃ ariyā ācikkhanti upekkhako satimā sukhavihārīti taṃ tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
mn94:25.1: sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānā, pubbeva somanassadomanassānaṃ atthaṅgamā, adukkhaṃ asukhaṃ upekkhā satiparisuddhiṃ catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
mn94:26.1: so evaṃ samāhite citte parisuddhe pariyodāte anaṅgaṇe vigatūpakkilese mudubhūte kammaniye ṭhite āneñjappatte pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇāya cittaṃ abhininnāmeti.
mn94:26.2: so anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarati, seyyathidaṃ: ekampi jātiṃ, dvepi jātiyo, tissopi …pe… anekepi saṃvaṭṭavivaṭṭakappe, amutrāsiṃ evaṃnāmo evaṃgotto evaṃvaṇṇo evamāhāro evaṃsukhadukkhapaṭisaṃvedī evamāyupariyanto, so tato cuto amutra udapādiṃ, tatrāpāsiṃ evaṃnāmo evaṃgotto evaṃvaṇṇo evamāhāro evaṃsukhadukkhapaṭisaṃvedī evamāyupariyanto, so tato cuto idhūpapanno’ti. iti sākāraṃ sauddesaṃ anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarati.
mn94:27.1: so evaṃ samāhite citte parisuddhe pariyodāte anaṅgaṇe vigatūpakkilese mudubhūte kammaniye ṭhite āneñjappatte sattānaṃ cutūpapātañāṇāya cittaṃ abhininnāmeti.
mn94:27.2: so dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena satte passati: cavamāne upapajjamāne hīne paṇīte suvaṇṇe dubbaṇṇe sugate duggate, yathākammūpage satte pajānāti: ime vata bhonto sattā kāyaduccaritena samannāgatā …pe… micchādiṭṭhikammasamādānā, te kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapannā. ime vā pana bhonto sattā kāyasucaritena samannāgatā …pe… sammādiṭṭhikammasamādānā, te kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapannāti. iti dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena satte passati: cavamāne upapajjamāne hīne paṇīte suvaṇṇe dubbaṇṇe sugate duggate, yathākammūpage satte pajānāti.
mn94:28.1: so evaṃ samāhite citte parisuddhe pariyodāte anaṅgaṇe vigatūpakkilese mudubhūte kammaniye ṭhite āneñjappatte āsavānaṃ khayañāṇāya cittaṃ abhininnāmeti.
mn94:28.2: so idaṃ dukkhanti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti, ayaṃ dukkhasamudayoti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti, ayaṃ dukkhanirodhoti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti, ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminīpaṭipadāti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti,
mn94:28.3: ime āsavāti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti, ayaṃ āsavasamudayoti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti, ayaṃ āsavanirodhoti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti, ayaṃ āsavanirodhagāminīpaṭipadāti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
mn94:29.1: tassa evaṃ jānato evaṃ passato kāmāsavāpi cittaṃ vimuccati, bhavāsavāpi cittaṃ vimuccati, avijjāsavāpi cittaṃ vimuccati.
mn94:29.3: khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānāti.
mn94:30.1: ayaṃ vuccati brāhmaṇa, puggalo nevattantapo nāttaparitāpanānuyogamanuyutto, na parantapo na paraparitāpanānuyogamanuyutto.
mn94:30.2: so anattantapo aparantapo diṭṭheva dhamme nicchāto nibbuto sītībhūto sukhapaṭisaṃvedī brahmabhūtena attanā viharatī’ti.
mn94:31.1: evaṃ vutte ghoṭamukho brāhmaṇo āyasmantaṃ udenaṃ etadavoca:
mn94:31.2: abhikkantaṃ bho udena, abhikkantaṃ bho udena,
mn94:31.3: seyyathāpi bho udena, nikkujjitaṃ vā ukkujjeyya, paṭicchannaṃ vā vivareyya, mūḷhassa vā maggaṃ ācikkheyya, andhakāre vā telapajjotaṃ dhāreyya cakkhumanto rūpāni dakkhintīti. evamevaṃ bhotā udenena anekapariyāyena dhammo pakāsito.
mn94:31.4: esāhaṃ bhavantaṃ udenaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi dhammañca bhikkhusaṅghañca.
mn94:31.5: upāsakaṃ maṃ bhavaṃ udeno dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gata’nti.
mn94:32.1: mā kho maṃ tvaṃ brāhmaṇa, saraṇaṃ agamāsi.
mn94:32.2: tameva tvaṃ bhagavantaṃ saraṇaṃ gaccha yamahaṃ saraṇaṃ gatoti.
mn94:32.3: kahaṃ pana bho udena, etarahi so bhavaṃ gotamo viharati arahaṃ sammāsambuddhoti?
mn94:32.4: parinibbuto kho brāhmaṇa, etarahi so bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddhoti.
mn94:32.5: sace hi mayaṃ bho udena, suṇeyyāma taṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ dasasu yojanesu, dasapi mayaṃ yojanāni gaccheyyāma taṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ dassanāya arahantaṃ sammāsambuddhaṃ.
mn94:32.6: sace mayaṃ bho udena, suṇeyyāma taṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ vīsatiyā yojanesu …pe…
mn94:32.9: paññāsāya yojanesu, paññāsampi mayaṃ yojanāni gaccheyyāma taṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ dassanāya arahantaṃ sammāsambuddhaṃ.
mn94:32.10: yojanasatepi mayaṃ bho udena, suṇeyyāma taṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ, yojanasatampi mayaṃ gaccheyyāma taṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ dassanāya arahantaṃ sammāsambuddhaṃ.
mn94:32.11: yato ca kho bho udena, parinibbuto so bhavaṃ gotamo, parinibbutampi mayaṃ taṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāma dhammañca bhikkhusaṅghañca.
mn94:32.12: upāsakaṃ maṃ bhavaṃ udeno dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gataṃ.
mn94:33.1: atthi ca me bho udena, aṅgarājā devasikaṃ niccabhikkhaṃ dadāti, tatohaṃ bhoto udenassa ekaṃ niccabhikkhaṃ dadāmīti.
mn94:33.2: kiṃ pana te brāhmaṇa, aṅgarājā devasikaṃ niccabhikkhaṃ dadātīti?
mn94:33.4: na kho no brāhmaṇa, kappati jātarūparajataṃ paṭiggahetunti.
mn94:33.5: sace taṃ bhoto udenassa na kappati, vihāraṃ bhoto udenassa kārāpessāmīti.
mn94:33.6: sace kho me tvaṃ brāhmaṇa, vihāraṃ kārāpetukāmo, pāṭaliputte saṅghassa upaṭṭhānasālaṃ kārāpehīti.
mn94:33.7: imināpahaṃ bhoto udenassa bhiyyosomattāya attamano abhiraddho, yaṃ maṃ bhavaṃ udeno saṅghe dāne samādapeti.
mn94:33.8: esāhaṃ bho udena, etissā ca niccabhikkhāya aparāya ca niccabhikkhāya pāṭaliputte saṅghassa upaṭṭhānasālaṃ kārāpessāmīti.
mn94:33.9: atha kho ghoṭamukho brāhmaṇo etissā ca niccabhikkhāya aparāya ca niccabhikkhāya pāṭaliputte saṅghassa upaṭṭhānasālaṃ kārāpesi.
